newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai refiner sells May 20-24 gasoline to Shell.
newsitem.headline: Thai refiner sells May 20-24 gasoline to Shell.

text.p: Thai refiner Rayong Refinery Co Ltd has awarded its tender to sell 200,000 barrels of 95-octane May unleaded gasoline to Shell Singapore, industry sources said on Thursday.

The cargo was sold at a 65-cent-per-barrel discount to Singapore spot quotes for 95-octane unleaded gasoline, on a free-on-board (fob) basis and would be loaded between May 20-24 from Rayong, they said.
The tender closed late on Wednesday.
The 145,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) Rayong refinery is 60-percent owned by Shell and 40-percent by state-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT).
In its last tender, the Thai refiner sold 230,000 barrels of 95-octane unleaded gasoline at $1.00 per barrel below Singapore 95-octane quotes, also to Shell Singapore on a fob basis.
